data.description: Discover urban sophistication at City Walk, where vibrant streets intersect with contemporary living.

data.answer:
City Walk Dubai is a dynamic lifestyle destination in the heart of Dubai, UAE. It offers a unique blend of upscale dining options, entertainment venues, apartments, and hotels in pedestrian-friendly surroundings.

City Walk shops range from high-end retail stores and boutiques to designer outlets catering to fashion, beauty, home decor, and more. Additionally, it features various restaurants, cafes, and eateries, offering a wide selection of international cuisines, from casual dining to fine dining experiences.

Residents of City Walk can find various entertainment options within the community, including cinemas, gaming arcades, and family-friendly attractions. The destination often hosts events, live performances, and exhibitions, adding to the vibrant atmosphere.

City Walk Al Wasl features luxury apartments and boutique hotels, providing residents and guests with premium accommodation options near the city center. The residences come with plenty of open spaces.

Off-Plan Projects in City Walk

Various projects in City Walk are currently under development. Here is the list of the top off-plan properties in the area:

City Walk Northline

Located next to Central Park, City Northline offers a curated selection of residences by Meraas. It introduces luxurious 1 to 3-bedroom apartments across 10 meticulously designed floors. 

Central Park Plaza

The upcoming property of Central Park Plaza consists of 1 to 4-bedroom apartments, opulent townhouses, or majestic 3-storey penthouses. The amenities include an outdoor gym, fitness station, outdoor BBQ areas, skateable landscape.

Central Park

It features 1 to 4-bedroom apartments amidst a lush green community. Central Park will feature kids' play area, dog park, outdoor gym, running track, and BBQ area.

Laurel

Laurel is the fifth phase of Central Park at City Walk. This project includes a collection of more than 200 residential units, featuring upscale 1 to 4-bedroom apartments and two exclusive penthouses. Every residence has one or more balconies offering breathtaking views of the neighboring park.

Rove City Walk 

Managed by Emaar Hospitality Group, Rove City Walk is a hotel apartment that offers lucrative investment opportunities. It features fully furnished rooms with excellent hotel amenities. 

Erin by Meraas

You can find 1 to 4-bedroom apartments in this premium property. Erin is a mid-rise building with 12 floors that also houses penthouses. It offers a range of amenities with various landmarks located nearby.

Thyme Central Park

It is a new residential development with 1 to 4-bedroom apartments. The premium homes in Thyme Central Park are situated amidst lush greenery, offering breathtaking views.

Properties for Rent in City Walk 

Explore the array of properties available for rent in City Walk. The rental prices for 1-bedroom apartments start at AED 100k. In Citywalk, the starting rent for 2-bedroom apartments is AED 135k. As for 3-bedroom flats, their rental rates start at AED 170k. The rental market presents a range of prices reflecting property sizes and amenities. Some units are furnished, while others are semi-furnished, contributing to the diversity in rental rates.

Properties for Sale in City Walk

Looking for properties for sale in City Walk? Luckily, there are plenty of options to choose from. The starting selling price for 1-bedroom apartments is AED 1.39M. For 2-bedroom apartments, prices range from AED 1.8M to 4M. In City Walk, 3-bedroom apartments are priced at AED 4.2M, while 4-bedroom flats start from AED 4.9 M. These properties present an enticing chance to reside in Dubai's most coveted locales. Prospective buyers and investors eyeing apartments in City Walk will discover competitive rates, particularly for spacious furnished units.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in City Walk?

data.answer:
Overall, City Walk Dubai offers a vibrant and cosmopolitan lifestyle experience, combining shopping, dining, entertainment, and leisure in a contemporary urban setting. It has become a popular destination for both residents and tourists seeking upscale experiences in Dubai.

Public Transportation in City Walk

For those depending on public transportation, commuting is convenient with numerous bus stops along Al Safa Street, just a brief 2-minute walk away. The closest stop, Dubai Petroleum Corporation 1, services buses C14, 28, 81, and 7.

Alternative transportation options near City Walk include accessing the nearest City Walk Metro Station. Burj Khalifa/Dubai Mall Metro Station is a mere 8-minute drive from the vicinity. If you are coming by car, Sheikh Zayed Road (E11) is easily accessible in under 10 minutes

Supermarkets in City Walk

City Walk boasts a variety of supermarkets catering to the diverse needs of its residents and visitors. Geant Express is a convenient option offering various groceries, fresh produce, and household essentials. Positioned as an express supermarket, Geant prioritizes efficiency without compromising selection, making it a favored choice for quick shopping trips.

Choithrams Loft Downtown is also a convenient nearby option. This supermarket chain provides a comprehensive range of groceries, including imported goods and multicultural offerings, and additional amenities like a bakery and deli counter. Known for its competitive pricing and loyalty programs, Carrefour provides a convenient one-stop shopping experience to City Walk residents. 

Shopping in City Walk

Shopping at City Walk offers a diverse and exciting experience with its range of stores, boutiques, and flagship outlets. City Walk is a prominent destination for upscale shopping, hosting a variety of luxury boutiques that showcase renowned international brands such as Ralph Lauren, Karl Lagerfeld, Chantelle, and Sephora.

Beyond City Walk, residents have many options with nearby well-known malls, including The Dubai Mall and Wasl Mall. The Dubai Mall is a premier shopping and leisure complex in Dubai, offering an extensive selection of high-end boutiques, dining establishments, a large department store, a cinema, and an ice rink. Conveniently located just a 6-minute drive away via Financial Centre Road (D71), it provides residents with unparalleled shopping and entertainment experiences. Also nearby is Galleria Mall Al Wasl, an excellent place for retail, dining, and entertainment.

Schools Near City Walk

Numerous educational institutions are available within the larger Jumeirah community, close to City Walk. Gems Wellington Primary School, located just 5 minutes away, follows the British curriculum from early years to grade 6. With well-equipped classrooms overseen by amiable and qualified teachers, children flourish in this environment. Great Mind’s Nursery is situated 6 minutes away in the Al Wasl community. For primary and secondary education, several reputable schools are easily accessible in the neighborhood.

Notable high schools near City Walk include Dubai Japanese School, JSS Private School, and Horizon English School. JSS Private School caters to over 2,000 students and follows the CBSE curriculum, fostering a passion for learning. It can be reached within a 6-minute drive. Horizon English School, located in Al Safa next to Al Safa Park, is a British school renowned for its welcoming atmosphere. It can also be reached within a 6-minute drive. A quick 5-minute drive to Umm Amar Road leads to Dubai Japanese School. For higher education, options include Canadian University Dubai, a respected institution just 3 minutes away from City Walk. Additionally, the Mohammed Bin Rashid University of Medicine and Health Sci

Churches, Temples, and Mosques Near City Walk Area 

There is a community mosque called City Walk Mosque in the area. It is a beautifully designed rust brown worship place with an Arabic font sculpture. Masjed Abdulsalam Al Rafi (Armed Forces Martyrs) is another mosque within the vicinity.

Among the Hindu temples near City Walk, Shree Krishna Haveli is a favored choice and is reachable within a 16-minute drive. St. Mary’s Catholic Church, situated on Oud Metha Road, can be reached by car in just 12 minutes. For those interested in visiting a Buddhist temple, the Mahamevnawa Buddhist Temple is the closest option at a 10-minute drive. 

Clinics and Hospitals in City Walk Dubai

Valiant Clinic is just a 4-minute drive away, while Emirates Clinic is another nearby medical facility, reachable within a 6-minute drive via Sheikh Zayed Road. Al Garhoud Private Hospital Clinic, a popular medical facility, is situated in the Jumeirah community, approximately 7 minutes away on 165b Jumeirah Street. Dubai London Clinic Dental Centre is the closest clinic to City Walk for dental care, requiring a 7-minute drive. Aster Clinic, a well-regarded clinic, is located in the neighboring district of Business Bay.

City Walk Location & Nearby Areas

City Walk enjoys proximity to numerous established residential communities and is conveniently positioned at the intersection of Safa Road and Al Wasl Road. Additionally, its close proximity to Sheikh Zayed Road (E11) enables residents to easily access neighboring communities such as Al Wasl, Al Satwa, Al Safa, and Business Bay. Residents of City Walk can also easily access Burj Khalifa located in Downtown Dubai.

more_info.question: Things to Do in City Walk

data.answer:
There is so much to do at City Walk, from fantastic retail choices to amazing nightlife options. Meanwhile, Coca-Cola Arena, City Walk Escape Room, and The Green Planet provide residents and visitors with excellent leisure facilities.

Restaurants In and Near City Walk Dubai

City Walk dining options are abundant, catering to various tastes and preferences. Pepe’s Piri Piri Restaurant, The Avenue Club, Mythos City Walk, and City Walk Starbucks are some of the top names.

Pepe’s Piri Piri Restaurant is one of the must-try restaurants in City Walk. Here you can have flavorful Portuguese-inspired cuisine, while The Avenue Club provides a sophisticated dining experience accompanied by live music and entertainment. Mythos City Walk transports diners to the heart of Greece with its authentic Mediterranean fare, while City Walk Starbucks offers the perfect spot to enjoy your favorite coffee beverages and light bites in a relaxed atmosphere. Whether you're craving international flavors or seeking a cozy cafe experience, City Walk has something to satisfy every palate.

Residents and visitors alike can explore a variety of dining experiences, including casual dining options like The Victorian Restaurant, Coya Dubai, Sarabeth’s, Enab Beirut, and Mint Leaf Restaurant. Among the charming cafes dotting City Walk, The Victorian Restaurant and Cafe is a homage to the Victorian era, boasting a timeless ambiance just a brief 5-minute stroll away.

For a sophisticated evening out, licensed bars like LookUp, a rooftop bar at La Ville Hotel & Suites, and La Casa Del on Al Wasl Street offer inviting atmospheres and tantalizing drink selections, adding to the allure of City Walk's social scene.

Beaches Near City Walk 

City Walk Dubai is conveniently located along Jumeirah Beach Road, surrounded by numerous beaches, offering a diverse range of choices for visitors. Within a short drive of less than 20 minutes, one can easily access a variety of beautiful beaches. These nearby beaches include JBR Beach, Barasti Beach, Jumeirah Public Beach, Sunset Beach, Kite Beach, and several others.

Hotels In and Near the City Walk Dubai Area

Situated within City Walk itself, La Ville Hotel & Suites offers a luxurious urban retreat for both leisure and business travelers. This contemporary hotel features elegant rooms and suites with modern amenities and stylish décor. Guests can indulge in gourmet dining at the hotel's restaurants, relax by the rooftop pool, or unwind with a spa treatment. With its prime location, La Ville Hotel & Suites provides easy access to the vibrant attractions of City Walk and beyond.

Located adjacent to City Walk, Rove City Walk offers a chic and budget-friendly accommodation option for travelers looking to explore Dubai's dynamic cityscape. The hotel's trendy rooms are designed with comfort and convenience in mind, featuring vibrant décor and tech-savvy amenities. Guests can enjoy a laid-back atmosphere at the hotel's leisure facilities, including a pool and fitness center, as well as easy access to City Walk's shopping, dining, and entertainment offerings.

Situated a short distance from City Walk, Dusit Thani Dubai provides a luxurious escape in the city's heart. This upscale hotel features spacious rooms and suites with Thai-inspired décor and panoramic city views. Guests can indulge in world-class dining experiences at the hotel's restaurants, unwind at the rooftop pool and spa, or host events and meetings in sophisticated venues. 

Attractions and Landmarks Near City Walk

NoWayOut Escape Room in City Walk offers an immersive and thrilling experience for adventure seekers and puzzle enthusiasts alike. Located within the vibrant City Walk district of Dubai, NoWayOut provides a range of escape room scenarios designed to challenge participants' problem-solving skills and teamwork abilities. The Green Planet and Coca-Cola Arena are among the leisure destinations and prominent landmarks within City Walk.

Offering an immersive journey into wildlife, The Green Planet is home to over 3,000 plants and animals within a captivating man-made forest. Visitors can explore various ecosystems, including Australian walkabouts, bat caves, and encounters with sloths, sugar gliders, reptiles, and a diverse array of birds from across the globe.

As one of the premier venues in the city, Coca-Cola Arena stands out as a hub for music tours, corporate sports events, and entertainment spectacles. With a seating capacity exceeding 17,000, it hosts a multitude of performances and gatherings, drawing crowds for unforgettable experiences.

You can also find Roxy Cinemas on City Walk. Thanks to the presence of this theatre, residents of City Walk don’t have to go too far from home to enjoy the latest flick. 

Outdoor Activities, Fitness, and Beauty

City Walk boasts an array of pathways, including promenades, avenues, and outdoor arenas, perfect for strolls. Each building within City Walk has designated play areas for children and inviting swimming pools, providing opportunities for residents to unwind and socialize in the evenings.

Lining the pedestrian boulevard are neatly arranged palm trees, adding to the serene ambiance of the area. Fitness enthusiasts will find convenience with various fitness centers nearby, such as Diamond Gym, Golden Arrow, and Smart Life Fitness Gym, all within a two-minute drive on Al Safa Street. Additionally, Bodylines Fitness and Wellness Club on Sheikh Zayed Road is just a five-minute drive away.

Residents can indulge in self-care at the numerous spas and salons scattered throughout the community. Among the popular choices in City Walk Dubai are Kerastase, N Bar, and 1847. Kerastase, renowned for its hair treatment services, is a mere five-minute drive away. N Bar offers top-notch nail treatment services, while 1847 caters to men's grooming needs, both conveniently located within the vicinity.

Being centrally located in Dubai, City Walk can experience heavy traffic congestion, especially during peak hours. This could result in longer commute times and frustration for residents who rely on driving.

What is special about City Walk Dubai?

There is so much to mention here. The community is the ideal place to live if you want your every weekend to be full of entertainment. You can find chic shops, beautifully designed outdoor spaces, al fresco restaurants and more in this stunning district.

How to go to City Walk Dubai by bus?

The nearest bus stop to City Walk Dubai is Dubai Petroleum Corporation 1, is served by buses C14, 28, 81, and 7.

How to go to City Walk Dubai by metro?

If you plan to visit by metro, board the red line and hop off at the Burj Khalifa/Dubai Mall Metro Station.

What to do in City Walk Dubai?

City Walk Dubai has plenty of activities and attractions to explore. You can shop at the upscale boutiques, fashion outlets, and designer stores or indulge in a culinary adventure at the many restaurants in the area.

Where is City Walk located?

City Walk is located at the junction of Al Wasl and Al Safa Road, accessible from Sheikh Zayed Road via Exit D71.

data.content:
City Walk Dubai is an urban community within Jumeirah. Renowned for its scenic strolls and vibrant ambiance, the neighborhood is one of Dubai's premier tourist destinations. Moreover, the community has various shopping and dining options.

Developed by Meeras, the City Walk area includes commercial properties and mid-rise residential buildings. Residents enjoy a luxurious lifestyle in a socially active, vibrant environment.

The neighborhood is close to Al Wasl Road and Sheikh Zayed Road and provides easy access to other areas and attractions. It is also well-connected with public transportation modes, such as the metro and buses.
